info.title: Jonathan Lloyd — Human Datastream
info.description:
Summarised biometric and cognitive metrics for Jonathan Lloyd, composed on data-change events by a backend Lambda and served as LLM-optimized markdown alongside canonical JSON.

The path carries the major version: v1. Within a version, response schemas only gain optional members. A removed member or a changed type ships as a new path version, and the old version keeps answering for at least 90 days. During that period its responses carry the Deprecation and Sunset headers and a Link header with rel="successor-version". A major release of the portal contract that removes or retypes an export member triggers a new version.

Each client gets 60 requests per minute. Every response from an export path under /api/v1 carries the RateLimit-Policy and RateLimit header fields from the IETF httpapi draft. A 429 response also carries Retry-After. The limit is a courtesy budget for a free, read-only API.

servers.description: The API base is https://jonathanlloyd.me/api/v1, and https://jonathanlloyd.me/openapi.json lists the nine export paths under it.
